# Test: Automatic rollback from broken split-rootfs image
# Scenario: monolith -> broken-split -> automatic rollback to monolith
#
# This test sends an OTA to a split image where the Extension is corrupted
# (random bytes instead of real erofs). The Core boots fine and connects to
# the controller, but extsloader fails dm-verity verification. nodeagent's
# testing window detects Extension not ready and does NOT mark TestComplete.
# After the testing window expires, the device reboots and falls back to
# the previous monolithic partition.
#
# Env vars:
#   EVE_VERSION  - broken split-rootfs version tag (required, with -broken-ext suffix)
#   EVE_REGISTRY - OCI registry path (default: lfedge/eve)

{{$eve_ver := "0.0.0"}}
{{$eve_registry := "lfedge/eve"}}

{{$env := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION"}}
{{if $env}}{{$eve_ver = $env}}{{end}}

{{$env_reg := EdenGetEnv "EVE_REGISTRY"}}
{{if $env_reg}}{{$eve_registry = $env_reg}}{{end}}

{{$eve_hv := "kvm"}}
{{$eve_arch := EdenConfig "eve.arch"}}
{{$short_version := printf "%s-%s-%s" $eve_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$test_info := "test eden.lim.test -test.v -timewait 30m -test.run TestInfo"}}

# Obtain the monolithic version we expect to roll back to
{{$mono_ver := EdenConfig "eve.tag"}}
{{$mono_hv := EdenConfig "eve.hv"}}
{{$mono_short := printf "%s-%s-%s" $mono_ver $mono_hv $eve_arch}}

# ── Step 1: Verify monolithic base ──────────────────────────
message 'Rollback: verifying monolithic base...'
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'monolithic'

# ── Step 2: Send OTA to broken split image ──────────────────
# Set short testing window so rollback happens faster
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.test.baseimage.update=120

message 'Rollback: sending broken split image update...'
eden -t 10m controller edge-node eveimage-update oci://docker.io/{{$eve_registry}}:{{$eve_ver}}-{{$eve_hv}}-{{$eve_arch}} -m adam://
! stderr .

# ── Step 3: Wait for broken image to boot (inprogress) ──────
# EVE will download, write Core to partition, reboot. Core boots fine
# but enters "inprogress" (testing) state — never reaches "active"
# because Extension fails dm-verity and nodeagent blocks TestComplete.
message 'Rollback: waiting for broken split image to boot (inprogress)...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:inprogress InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $short_version }}'
stdout '{{ $short_version }}'

# ── Step 4: Wait for automatic rollback ─────────────────────
# nodeagent sees /etc/ext-verity-roothash (Extension expected) but
# extsloader can't mount (dm-verity fails on corrupted Extension).
# nodeagent triggers reboot after testing window (120s) expires →
# device falls back to previous monolithic partition.
#
# We wait for the monolithic version to become active again.
message 'Rollback: waiting for automatic rollback to monolithic...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:active InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $mono_short }}'
stdout '{{ $mono_short }}'

# ── Step 5: Wait for SSH and verify monolithic ───────────────
message 'Rollback: waiting for SSH after rollback...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

message 'Rollback: verifying rolled back to monolithic...'
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'monolithic'

eden eve ssh 'echo alive'
stdout 'alive'

message 'Rollback: SUCCESS - automatic rollback from broken split to monolithic worked'

# Reset config
eden eve reset

# Test's config file
-- eden-config.yml --
test:
    controller: adam://{{EdenConfig "adam.ip"}}:{{EdenConfig "adam.port"}}
    eve:
      {{EdenConfig "eve.name"}}:
        onboard-cert: {{EdenConfigPath "eve.cert"}}
        serial: "{{EdenConfig "eve.serial"}}"
        model: {{EdenConfig "eve.devmodel"}}

-- wait-ssh.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
    if timeout 10 $EDEN eve ssh echo ssh-ready 2>/dev/null; then
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 5
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "SSH not available after 150s"
exit 1
